verdict.rationale: Solid components are plain JavaScript functions that return JSX, so markup and rendering logic live together in one component. They are written in JSX and TypeScript, languages developers already know, so there is no new rendering system to learn. Missing for 10: any documented way to colocate styles within the component, and independent hands-on corroboration of the single-file authoring experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write markup and rendering logic together in a single component using markup, styles, and a language I already know

citations.quote: your components are regular JavaScript functions that run once to set up your view
Provides modern framework features like JSX, fragments, Context, Portals
you're free to organize your code how you like and you don't have to learn a new rendering system
Solid is built on established tools like JSX and TypeScript
